src: Not a gloss at all — a dictionary's grammatical note about the noun's origin, shipped where the English translation belongs, and the string a learner is graded against in recall mode. The definition already on the card («Something that a person plans to do») is what it should have said.

expect.en: tackle, fishing rod, line, and rod)

src: A truncation of the card's own definition — «tackle, fishing rod (angler's tool consisting of hook (Haken), line (Schnur), and rod (Rute))» — with the parenthesis lost, so the gloss reads as four senses of which two are parts of the thing and one is an unmatched bracket.
